title: The Ten Chariots: How Jesus the Son Clothes Himself for the Descent
description: Jesus the Son of the Greatness, in coming to the world, successively mounts ten vehicles — vessel of light, chariot of First Man with tabernacle, Pillar of Glory, the Call worn upon his body, the Answer/Hearing, and the five living elements (Air, Wind, Light, Water, Fire) — clothing himself at each discrete degree until he is finally unveiled in the cosmic Girdle. The descent is not a single motion but a graduated accommodation through ten successive mounts.
